verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents first-party AuthKit framework SDKs for Next.js (server- and client-side utilities), Astro (session validation and route protection), TanStack Start, React and Laravel, which covers the core of protecting routes with framework SDKs. The docs excerpts never explicitly mention middleware or edge-runtime session verification, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of middleware-based session verification at the edge (e.g., Next.js middleware), independent or hands-on corroboration of route protection.
